column2: NOT WRITTEN HERE. NO LONGER FORCED ON ANY USER (2026-09-01)
column3: It is a one-sided Jacobi SVD of the design matrix and this library does not have one. cuML olsFit defaults to algo=0, so their C++ default is this solver and ours is algo=1 (lstsqEig), which is also what their PYTHON door defaults to. THE TWO SHAPES THEIR DISPATCH FORCED TO IT NO LONGER REFUSE: n_cols == 1 takes lstsq_eig (DEVIATION 551) and n_cols > n_rows takes lstsq_min_norm (DEVIATION 550, glm/impl/linalg/detail/lstsq_min_norm.mojo). What remains missing is an ACCURACY property, not a capability: an SVD route never forms a Gram matrix and so never squares the condition number, while every least-squares route here does. On a badly conditioned design ours loses about twice the digits. The algorithms that would close that are an LQ factorization or a one-sided Jacobi SVD of A^T; neither is written. An EXPLICIT algo=0 raises by name in glm/impl/glm/ols.mojo and no Python door can ask for it

olsFit's algo 2 and 3. Nothing in any dispatch forces a caller to either; both raise by name if asked for explicitly. lstsqQR (a Householder QR) is the cheapest route that would NOT square the condition number and is the obvious next accuracy improvement for both the tall and the wide side

column3: The sentence that stood here -- "ridge is lstsqEig with alpha added to the eigenvalues before inverting. Cheap once wanted" -- was WRONG about their design: ridgeEig is svdEig (an SVD via the Gram's eigendecomposition, U = A V / S) followed by ridgeSolve's six RAFT ops with two ABSOLUTE thresholds on a singular value; see glm/impl/glm/ridge.mojo. ridgeSVD needs cuSOLVER gesvd (svdQR), no equivalent; n_cols == 1 forces it (ridge.cuh:210) and is refused by name. ridgeSolve's thres=1e-10 and svdEig's 1e-10 are absolute, the OLS_NONZERO_THRESH deviation again, carried and gated (ridge.solve.nnz is the card's integer stage)

Same defect class as jacobi_eigh_device.mojo DEVIATION BLOCK 1, which was fixed by making the test relative. NOT fixed here because glm/ported is COPY-DO-NOT-IMPROVE and the change moves shipped NUMERIC_FAST bits near the boundary. Identity consequence: the comparison's output is a RANK, so at the boundary a per-vendor last bit changes how many directions the model has, not its fifth decimal
